newsitem.title: UK: Smiths Industries climbs after results.
newsitem.headline: Smiths Industries climbs after results.

text.p: Shares in Smiths Industries rose in a falling market on Wednesday after the diversified industrial group announced annual profits and a dividend at the top end of market expectations.
Smiths Industries shares were up 3-1/2p at 795p in an otherwise weak pre-market. Some 257,900 shares had changed hands by 0731 GMT.
The company posted pre-tax profit of 165 million stg and a dividend of 16.2p per share for the year to August 3, 1996.
Analysts had forecast profits between 159 million and 165 million stg and a dividend between 15.7p and 16.0p.
"It's all in the figures -- they were at the top end of forecasts. But the market is looking a bit dull so it might be hard for them to put on weight today," one marketmaker said.
Dealers also noted that Smiths Industries shares have rallied in recent sessions ahead of the figures, moving back toward their October 1 intraday peak of 810p.

"They were pretty good and cashflow was a bit better than expected...The outlook tends to be improving and Boeing's decision to accelerate production rates of its 737 aircraft augurs well," SocGen analyst Andy Chambers said.
Operating cashflow rose to 149 million stg in 1996 from 140 million a year earlier.
Chambers said SocGen recommended holding Smiths Industries stock at present and had no plans to change that rating.
"We're long-term positive on the stock but feel the share has had such a strong run it is up with events," he said.
